Message from a genetic counsellor
---------------------------------

I have written up the result letter for a family I am seeing on Thursday. The mother has
told me more than once that the last letter from us "may as well have been in another
language", and she is right — I read it back and it is not usable.

Could you put the interpretation paragraph below into something I can actually give her?
She reads English fine, this is not a language issue, it is that we write for each other
and not for her. I will check whatever you produce against the record before it goes out.

Interpretation paragraph as written:

  Trio exome sequencing identified a heterozygous variant in ARID1B,
  NM_020732.3:c.4318C>T p.(Arg1440Ter), absent from population databases and
  confirmed de novo by segregation analysis. This nonsense variant is predicted to
  result in a truncated transcript subject to nonsense-mediated decay, and
  haploinsufficiency is the established disease mechanism for this gene. The variant
  is classified as likely pathogenic (PVS1, PS2, PM2). Penetrance is considered high
  though expressivity is variable. Correlation with the clinical phenotype is advised.
  Secondary findings were not analysed at the family's request.
